verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents an official MCP server built into flyctl, but it is explicitly labeled experimental, and the evidence is a single command-reference line. Docs about hosting MCP servers on Machines or Sprites describe a hosting platform for third-party servers, not an official Fly.io MCP server, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: stable (non-experimental) status, documentation of the exposed tools and how to connect an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
